startmeasure.title: Measure
startmeasure.remarks: Absolute distance taken from the start of the linear asset to where this measure point is defined  This can be manually entered or calculated by entering start/end reference points and offsets.

genalertupperwarn.title: Generate Alert for Upper Warning Limit
genalertupperwarn.remarks: Select the checkbox to generate Alert when a Measurement is entered between the Measure Point's Upper Warning Limit and Upper Action Limit.

upperwarning.title: Upper Warning Limit
upperwarning.remarks: The lower of the two high reading values. A reading between this level and the upper action limit (UAL) indicates potential trouble.

endzoffset.title: End Z Offset
endzoffset.remarks: Distance above or below this linear asset.  For example, if a sign is 10 feet above the road, the  Z-Offset is 10 feet.  This value is measured from the Z  Reference Point and can be positive (above) or negative (below).

llpmnum.title: Lower Limit PM
llpmnum.remarks: Lower Limit (LL) PMNUM is the PM that is used to generate a work order when a Measurement is entered below the MeasurePoint's Lower Limit.

metername.title: Meter
metername.remarks: Name of meter associated with this MeasurePoint

startoffset.title: Start Offset
startoffset.remarks: Distance used in conjunction with the start reference point to determine where the measurepoint resides.

ulpriority.title: Upper Limit Priority
ulpriority.remarks: Work priority for the Upper Limit PM or job plan

llpriority.title: Lower Limit Priority
llpriority.remarks: Work priority for the Lower Limit PM or job plan

uljpnum.title: Upper Limit Job Plan
uljpnum.remarks: Upper Limit (UL) JPNUM is the job plan that is used to generate a work order when a Measurement is entered above the MeasurePoint's Upper Limit.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: Description of the selected measurement point.

endoffset.title: End Offset
endoffset.remarks: Distance used in conjunction with the end reference point to determine where the measurepoint resides.

restrictduration.title: Duration
restrictduration.remarks: Duration till Alerts will be not generated after last generated Alert.

restrictunit.title: Unit of Duration
restrictunit.remarks: Unit of Duration for restricting alert generation.

ulpmnum.title: Upper Limit PM
ulpmnum.remarks: Upper Limit (UL) PMNUM is the PM that is used to generate a work order when a Measurement is entered above the MeasurePoint's Upper Limit.

assetnum.title: Asset
assetnum.remarks: Asset Number The Measurement Refers To

endyoffsetref.title: End Y Offset Referent
endyoffsetref.remarks: Starting point from which to measure the end Y-Offset at the end of the section of the linear asset to which this condition monitoring measurepoint applies.  GUARDRAIL and SURFACE are two examples.

loweraction.title: Lower Action Limit
loweraction.remarks: The lower of the two low reading values. A reading at this level or lower indicates that a corrective action is needed.

startzoffset.title: Start Z Offset
startzoffset.remarks: Distance above or below this linear asset.  For example, if a sign is 10 feet above the road, the  Z-Offset is 10 feet.  This value is measured from the Z  Reference Point and can be positive (above) or negative (below).

startzoffsetref.title: Start Z Offset Referent
startzoffsetref.remarks: Reference point from which the start Z-Offset (distance above or below the linear asset) is measured.

startyoffsetref.title: Start Y Offset Referent
startyoffsetref.remarks: Starting point from which to measure the Y-Offset at the start of the section of the linear asset to which this condition monitoring measurepoint applies.  CURB and CENTER-LINE are two examples.

endmeasure.title: Measure
endmeasure.remarks: Absolute distance taken from the start of the linear asset to where the end of this measure point is defined  This can be manually entered or calculated by entering an end reference point and end offset.

startyoffset.title: Start Y Offset
startyoffset.remarks: Perpendicular distance from this linear asset.  For example, if a sign is 10 feet to the right of the road, the Y-Offset is 10 feet.  This value is measured from the Y Reference Point and can be positive (right) or negative (left).

genalertlowerwarn.title: Generate Alert for Lower Warning Limit
genalertlowerwarn.remarks: Select the checkbox to generate Alert when a Measurement is entered between the Measure Point's Lower Warning Limit and Lower Action Limit.

endyoffset.title: End Y Offset
endyoffset.remarks: Perpendicular distance from this linear asset.  For example, if a sign is 10 feet to the right of the road, the Y-Offset is 10 feet.  This value is measured from the Y Reference Point and can be positive (right) or negative (left).

lowerwarning.title: Lower Warning Limit
lowerwarning.remarks: The lower of the two low reading values. A reading at this level or lower indicates that a corrective action is needed.

lljpnum.title: Lower Limit Job Plan
lljpnum.remarks: Lower Limit (LL) JPNUM is the job plan that is used to generate a work order when a Measurement is entered below the MeasurePoint's Lower Limit.

upperaction.title: Upper Action Limit
upperaction.remarks: The higher of the two high reading values. A reading at this level or higher indicates that a corrective action is needed.

endzoffsetref.title: End Z Offset Referent
endzoffsetref.remarks: Point from which the Z-Offset is measured.
